This is second bail application under Section 483 of BNSS for grant of regular bail in connection with crime No.55/2021, dated : not mentioned, registered at P.S. - Shipra District - Indore for offences punishable under Sections 363, 366, 376(2)(n) of IPC and Section 5(L)/6 of POCSO Act.
The applicant is in jail since 15/2/2021.
Considering the same a status report was called.
As per the status report out of 14 prosecution witnesses 7 have been examined.
The prosecutrix and her father have already been examined and the prosecutrix has supported the prosecution case.
As per birth certificate her age was less than 15 years on the date of incident.
